messages:
Maya (finance): Heads-up: new procurement guidance effective next month. Key changes: p-card single-charge cap lowered to $1,000; recurring subscriptions > $100/mo must be entered in the intake; delegated approvals allowed for low-risk SaaS up to $2k/yr. Details + intake: https://docs.redwood.internal/q1-procurement-2026 :loudspeaker:
Owen (procurement): Quick clarifications: delegated approvals = team lead sign-off on intake form (no legal/security PII). Anything that handles customer data is excluded. We'll auto-generate PO on approval.
Lee (eng): For Marketplace charges billed through cloud provider, treat them as recurring third-party vendors?
Owen (procurement): Yes 11 include marketplace-managed charges if billed by an external vendor on your invoice.
Nina (security): Reminder: any vendor touching PII/PHI requires security review and is never eligible for delegation. Mark "handles_pii" on the form. SLA ~3 business days.
ops-bot: Procurement intake form updated at 09:00 UTC. Fields: vendor_name, monthly_estimate, cost_center, owner_email, contract_term, handles_pii.
Maya (finance): Timeline: update recurring vendors in the intake by 2026-01-28 COB. Non-whitelisted vendors after the sweep may face delayed onboarding/payments. For exceptions, file #help-procurement and tag @Owen.
Lee (eng): Will update our billing export and paste CSV rows into the intake. Thanks. :thumbsup:
